jobs.title: Transportation Engineering Co-op Student
jobs.description:
Job Details

Student (Non-UnionT)

Posting Status

Open to all current Town of Oakville employees and external applicants.

Duration

8-12 months

Closing Date

Applications for this position must be received at by no later than 11:59pm on December 2, 2026.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy and therefore will be filled accordingly.

Reporting to the Manager of Transportation Planning, this position will assist with development reviews, transportation planning studies, environmental assessments, and initiatives that advance the Town's sustainable transportation objectives. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work alongside transportation engineers and planners on a variety of projects that support improvements to mobility, active transportation, and community connectivity.

Job Responsibilities

Conducts research and analyses to support all transportation planning initiatives, such as development planning and engineering review, sustainable transportation projects and programs, environmental assessment studies, and the development and implementation of the transportation master plan.
Assists with the review and assessment of transportation related studies for land development plans to support transportation planning initiatives and municipal development review process.
Assists in reviewing road and intersection layouts to identify opportunities to improve pedestrian and cyclist safety, accessibility and multimodal connectivity in accordance with applicable municipal standards and guidelines.
Supports the planning and evaluation of active transportation infrastructure, including sidewalks, cycling facilities, multi-use trails, pedestrian crossings.
Assists with traffic counts, turning movement counts, pedestrian and cyclist surveys, and preliminary traffic operational analyses to support transportation planning studies.
Assists with interested parties engagement and public outreach initiatives, including travel demand management programs, Smart Commute activities, micro-mobility and shared mobility studies, and the preparation and delivery of promotional materials, events and educational campaigns supporting walking, cycling and transit use.
Maintain project management workbooks, biweekly updates and other project management-related activities as assigned.
Performs site visits and surveys to confirm sight triangles, measure distances and review and document existing site conditions.
Participates in all mandatory and technical trainings.
Be responsible to work in compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act and Regulations, the Town of Oakville Policies and Procedures, as well as established industry guidelines.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a university program in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering or related Engineering program.
Knowledge of transportation engineering principles and demonstrated interest in transportation planning/engineering.
Ability to conduct research, literature reviews, technical/statistical analyses on transportation impacts to our society, culture, economy, and natural environment.
Capable of working well individually and in a team environment.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience using transportation planning and engineering software such as ArcGIS, AutoCAD and Synchro, along with familiarity with Microsoft Excel and data visualization tools.
Strong organizational, analytical, verbal, written and interpersonal skills are essential, as well as the ability to deal effectively with the public.
The successful candidate must hold a valid and unrestricted Ontario Driver’s License Class G/G2 minimum and will be required to supply their own personal vehicle for performing job duties/corporate business.

DATED:
November 25, 2026

The Town’s recruitment software includes elements of artificial intelligence to assist in the screening and short-listing of qualified candidates.

This job profile reflects the general requirements necessary to perform the principal functions of the job. This does not include all of the work requirements of the job. Applicants are required to demonstrate through their application and in the interview process that their qualifications match those specified. Applicants may also be required to undergo testing.

We thank all applicants and advise that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future , is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien. 

Job Summary

An exciting co-op opportunity awaits a motivated student at our Saskatoon corporate office
, beginning January - August 2027
for an approximately 8-month term
. This is a temporary, full-time, hourly-paid position
available to current students who will be returning to their studies following completion of the work term
.

What You'll Do

Initiate and execute capital projects from initiation through project completion, with projects ranging in total cost from $50K - $500K
Collaborate with process engineers and site personnel to develop key project deliverables, including funding requests, stage gate reviews, and requests for proposals
Work with Senior Manager, TD&L Capital to improve monthly capital reporting processes and data analysis for the Terminals Capital portfolio

What You'll Bring

Currently enrolled in a 4 year Engineering degree (Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, Electrical preferred) or equivalent related program with a graduation date of Aug 2026 or later

Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!  

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law. 

Please be advised that pre-screen interviews may be transcribed (there will be no audio or video recording) and that artificial intelligence tools may be used to summarize the transcript of the discussion. These tools will not be used to make or influence hiring decisions. Biometric identifiers and biometric information will not be captured. jobs.title: Field Engineering Co-op
jobs.description:
Company Description

Veolia is a global leader in environmental services, operating across all five continents with nearly 218,000 employees. Specializing in water, energy, and waste management, Veolia designs and implements innovative solutions for decarbonization, depollution, and resource regeneration, supporting communities and industries in their ecological transformation. Within this framework, Water Tech brings together a dedicated team of experienced professionals committed to tackling the world’s most complex challenges related to water scarcity, quality, productivity, and energy. Together, we pursue a shared mission to create a more sustainable future.

Job Description

As the Field Engineering Intern,
you will be joining a strong technical service environment. In this role, you will have an opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals within the field of industrial water treatment. You will gain exposure supporting water treatment systems and assist the organization in achieving its annual goals and objectives as an active participant.

This is a full-time co-op with an anticipated start date in May 2027 through August 2028. The job location will be based in Hamilton, ON.

Nature Of Work

Your responsibilities will include (but are not limited to);

Generate system drawings, PFDs, for use in on-site manuals and proposals
Conduct wet testing in laboratory on water samples
Actively monitor process equipment performance through online tools
Assist in completing monthly reporting requirements
Manage bulk chemical inventory and assist with ordering chemical products as required
Perform field checks on process equipment (flows, pH, conductivity, chemical residuals, etc.)
Work with supervisors on plant equipment optimization opportunities

Qualifications

Experience performing basic chemical tasks such as titrations, pH & conductivity measurements, and using other simple chemistry lab instruments
Basic mechanical skills to help troubleshoot chemical feed equipment
Computer skills - use of Microsoft Office, Visio, and online data Management
Strong teamwork & communication skills
Ability to prioritize and maintain deliverables in a fast-paced work environment
Full-time availability starting May 2027 through August 2028

Education

Rising Junior or Senior pursuing an undergraduate degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Chemistry

Additional Information

Why Veolia?

Join a company that values Responsibility, Solidarity, Innovation, Customer Focus, and Respect. You'll have opportunities for comprehensive leadership development, career advancement, and the chance to make a meaningful impact on sustainability and environmental protection while leading a talented team.

At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger communities. We’re an organization that champions diversity and inclusion at every rung of the ladder and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We offer challenging and meaningful careers, and because our people are our greatest assets, we also offer competitive compensation and benefits.

Compensation

The compensation range is tied to the market for similarly benchmarked roles. The range is not an absolute, but a guide, and offers will be based on the individual candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, as well as internal peer equity. Depending upon all the preceding considerations for the final selected individual candidate, the offer may be lower or higher than the stated range: $24.72-$27.30 CAD.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure

We do not use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.

Vacancy Status

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

****Candidates must be immediately eligible to work legally in Canada; the employer will not sponsor candidates for a work permit or any other Canadian work authorization for this opportunity. ****

Veolia does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiting firms. All vendors must have a current and fully executed MSA on file before submitting candidates. Any unsolicited resumes and candidate profiles will be deemed the property of the company and no fee will be due.

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you looking for a rewarding career where you can make an impact? One with advancement opportunities? Do you have a passion to help others?

If you answered YES
to any of the above, then this may be the perfect opportunity for you! We want YOU to join our growing team and partner with other exceptional team members dedicated to providing a level of services

unique to the industry.

Veolia is seeking thoughtful, dedicated professionals to join our ever growing team as we deliver leading water treatment solutions for clients across municipal and industrial markets, in locations on six continents. Finding solutions to the world's biggest water use and reuse problems has never been more important than it is right now.

Working at Veolia means helping people. Our careers have purpose and are vital to everyday quality of life. Veolia’s mission is to resource the world and we hope you will join us!

Job Description

As part of the Electrical, Instrumentation and Controls (EI&C) team you will work collaboratively with a cross-functional engineering team. You will participate in a wide range of design activities and help with developing the control panel design, performing calculations related to instrumentation selection, developing process control documents and generating PLC/HMI programs for cutting-edge water and wastewater treatment systems.

In this role, your responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

Collaborate in project design review meetings.
Help create single line diagrams, load lists and control panel schematic drawings.
Perform required calculations to select the appropriate instrumentation for water treatment facilities and prepare supporting documentation (instrument & valve lists, instrument & valve datasheets, instrument installation diagrams, etc.).
Develop controls documents and PLC/HMI Programs for water and wastewater treatment systems.
Contribute to the development of company standards and templates.
Develop team productivity tools.
Support with project issue resolution related to design, start-up and performance.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a Bachelor of Science or Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or other related technical discipline.
Ability to work a full-time co-op starting May 2027 for 12-16 months
Passion for the environment and water treatment.
Self-motivated, quick to deliver, and a team player.
Able to demonstrate a dedication to safety and effective problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and through technical writing.
Comfortable with a fast-paced, collaborative, work environment.
Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain relationships with co-workers.

While on-the-job training will be provided, candidates may benefit from previous knowledge

And Exposure In The Following Areas

Understanding of hydraulics and fundamentals of fluid mechanics.
Understanding of basic water chemistry and/or treatment processes.
Understanding of process flow diagrams (PFD), piping & instrumentation diagrams (P&ID), process controls, and electrical design concepts.
Water treatment experience would be an asset.

Additional Information

You'll have opportunities for comprehensive leadership development, career advancement, and the chance to make a meaningful impact on sustainability and environmental protection while leading a talented team.

Depending upon all the preceding considerations for the final selected individual candidate, the offer may be lower or higher than the stated range: $23.00 - $27.00 CAD.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Construction and Equipment Division, a part of the J.D. Irving, Limited’s group of companies, is a key player in the North American construction industry. Our core businesses are Irving Equipment, Gulf Operators, CFM, Irving Wallboard, and Kent Homes and the group provides heavy equipment and crane services, civil construction, modular home and commercial buildings, and machining, technical services, repair and overhaul to its customers.

We are now accepting applications to our  CONSTRUCT YOUR CAREER
 development program. We are hiring students who are looking for challenge , have a passion for learning beyond the classroom, are highly energetic and motivated to  CONSTRUCT YOUR CAREER.

What You’ll Get:

An opportunity to start CONSTRUCTING your career within a dynamic division that will allow you to gain meaningful and business impacting work experience. You will be provided with hands-on projects where you will be able to apply your studies. In addition, you will gain exposure to top leaders within our Division and get exposure to other J.D. Irving, Limited companies to expand your professional NETWORK. Your work term will include a solid combination of practical experience and professional development opportunities that will prepare you to be a future LEADER within our Divisional talent pipeline.

We currently have an engaging opportunity for a  COMPUTER SCIENCE/ COMPUTER ENGINEER STUDENT.

Responsibilities

Exposure to planning and scheduling of system upgrades and implementation through testing and education
Provide recommendations on establishing standards and other practical applications.
Help prepare technical reports.
Assist more experienced staff with technical aspects of more complex tasks.
Help commission and troubleshoot systems.
Participate in technical audits on site.
Identify business needs and create solutions to enhance our competitive edge using various software.
Training and utilization of company ERP, dashboards and analytics
Job shadow opportunities and establishment of mentor relationships

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a Bachelor of Science Computer Science or Engineering university program
Interest in developing background in research, development and rollout of solutions
Desire to develop Project management skillset (Six Sigma, Lean, MS Projects, Gantt Charts)
Desire to strengthen skills interpreting customer needs and providing a solution
Ability to multi-task and recognize changing priorities
Attention to detail

All of our student roles will require full time enrollment in a related post-secondary program in good academic standing, excellent communication, analytic and organizational skills, and a great attitude with an eagerness to learn.

If you are a full time student looking to  CONSTRUCT YOUR CAREER
, please apply online!

About Us

Founded in 1882, J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) operates in Eastern Canada (New-Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Québec, Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador), as well as in USA. We are a team of 20,000 dedicated employees. At J.D. Irving, Limited, you are part of a dynamic team of professionals who lead with integrity and are passionate about delivering results. With a culture that nurtures talent and creates an inclusive workplace, you can grow your career across our various operating divisions.

We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates, and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary, or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.

Worried you do not meet all the requirements? Studies have shown that many applicants apply only to job opportunities when they feel they meet 100% of the criteria. We promote an inclusive environment where everyone is appreciated, recognized, and empowered to contribute fully. If you are interested in this position but are worried you did not meet all the requirements, we would encourage you to still apply.

Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

We appreciate your interest in our company however only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

About The Team

Join Irving Equipment , the largest provider of crane rental, heavy lifting, specialized transportation, pile driving, and wind energy services in Atlantic Canada. With over 100 cranes in our fleet, ranging from 8 to 770 tons, we are equipped to handle projects of any size across Eastern Canada and the Northeastern US. For more than 60 years, Irving Equipment has been setting the standard for excellence in industrial, commercial, infrastructure, and residential construction. As an ISO 9001 certified company, we offer the advantage of in-house engineering, custom technology, and expert project management to ensure seamless execution from start to finish. If you're looking to be part of a team that takes on the toughest lifting and moving challenges, Irving Equipment is the place to build your career !

jobs.description:
Job Description

To be eligible for Pomerleau’s internship program, you must meet the following criteria:

Be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of application and for the entire duration of the internship.
Reside in Canada at the time of application and for the entire duration of the internship.
Be duly enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution or have graduated from such an institution within no more than six (6) months prior to the internship start date.

If you graduated more than six (6) months ago, please refer to our permanent job opportunities.

Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.

Build your future with us!

Join Pomerleau as an Estimation Intern and gain hands-on experience supporting major construction projects across Canada.

Pomerleau is a national leader in construction, delivering major projects across Canada. We believe in creating a workplace where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and a shared commitment to doing great work. We invest in our people and create opportunities to grow, thrive, and have fun.

What you will do

Lead the comprehensive bid process with a commitment to precision and excellence.
Employ research expertise to identify project-specific pricing for labor, equipment, and materials. Skillfully interpret technical specifications for accurate and meticulous bidding.
Execute thorough quantity take-offs, guaranteeing precision in contract specifications and pricing.
Foster a client-centric approach, aligning proposed bids with project feasibility.
Cultivate and sustain strong relationships with trade partners, consultants, and clients.
Provide valuable assistance to the team, actively contributing to a collaborative office environment.

This role could be for you if you have

Must be currently enrolled in a recognized Engineering or Construction Management degree or diploma program.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Qualities such as versatile, curious, meticulous, and eager to actively participate.
Passion for the construction industry.

Benefits

Hands-on Learning in construction, engineering, sustainability, and tech
Mentorship from experienced professionals
Strong Networking with managers, engineers, and executives
Industry Insight through events, site visits, and team meetings
Career Growth into roles like project coordinator or site engineer
Full-Time Potential with high intern-to-employee conversion

For the past six years, we've proudly held the distinction of being one of Canada's Top 100 Employers.

The expected compensation range posted for this role applies to available work locations in Ontario and/or British Columbia. Offered compensation may vary from the posted range based on a candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and the final job for which they are hired.

Please view this job on Pomerleau’s official Career Site if the posted compensation range is unavailable on a third‑party job board.
